description: Interactive SVG illustrations, animated dashboard cards, virtual labs visual upgrade, and performance optimization via code splitting. This feature completes the visual transformation: (1) Replace static icons with inline SVG vector illustrations for key dashboard elements, (2) Add animated/interactive illustrations to admin and quality dashboards, (3) Upgrade virtual labs with interactive preview cards, (4) Implement React.lazy code splitting for heavy page routes.
steps: Create `frontend/src/components/illustrations/index.tsx` - Export a set of SVG-based illustration components: (a) `HeroIllustration` - an abstract learning/growth SVG with animated gradient paths (uses CSS animation). (b) `AiBrainIllustration` - a neural network style SVG for AI pages. (c) `LabBeakerIllustration` - an animated beaker/flask SVG for labs. (d) `AchievementStarIllustration` - a star burst SVG for gamification. (e) `DashboardWaveIllustration` - a wave pattern SVG for dashboard backgrounds. Each illustration should be a React component rendering inline SVG with CSS class names for animation (defined in world-class.css). Keep them minimal (under 50 lines each) but visually distinct.

Add illustration animation keyframes to `frontend/src/styles/world-class.css` - Add `.illustration-float` (gentle float up/down), `.illustration-pulse` (scale pulse), `.illustration-draw` (stroke-dashoffset animation for SVG path drawing effect), `.illustration-gradient-shift` (animated gradient via background-position or SVG gradient stops).

Update `frontend/src/pages/student/DashboardPage.tsx` - Add the `DashboardWaveIllustration` as a decorative background element in the welcome-card header. Add `GamificationWidget` component in the dashboard layout (positioned after the quick-stats section, before the hero KPIs).

Update `frontend/src/pages/student/LabsPage.tsx` - Add `LabBeakerIllustration` in the page header area. Enhance lab cards with hover micro-interactions: on hover, show an animated preview overlay with a 'Start Lab' call-to-action. Add CSS classes for the lab card hover state in world-class.css.
Update `frontend/src/pages/student/AiAssistantPage.tsx` - Add `AiBrainIllustration` in the page header. Add subtle animation to the AI chat area (typing indicator with animated dots).

Implement code splitting in `frontend/src/App.tsx` - Use React.lazy() and Suspense for heavy page routes: (a) Lazy-load all page directories (student, teacher, admin, quality, owner, vision). (b) Wrap lazy routes in <Suspense fallback={<PageSkeleton />}>. (c) Group related pages into chunk names using Vite's dynamic import comments. This improves initial load performance without SSR.
Update `frontend/vite.config.ts` - Add additional manual chunks for the lazy-loaded page groups to optimize bundle splitting.
acceptance_criteria: At least 5 SVG illustration components exist in illustrations/index.tsx
Illustrations use CSS animations (not JavaScript animation libraries)
DashboardPage includes the wave illustration and GamificationWidget
LabsPage has enhanced hover interactions on lab cards
AiAssistantPage has the brain illustration and typing indicator animation
App.tsx uses React.lazy for at least the major page groups
Suspense boundaries use PageSkeleton from primitives/States.tsx as fallback
vite.config.ts has additional manual chunks for page groups
TypeScript compilation passes with no errors
verification: Run `npx tsc -b --noEmit` in frontend/ directory to confirm type-check passes
Run `npx vite build` in frontend/ directory to confirm build succeeds and shows chunk output
